summary: Cartesia's $0 Free plan includes 20,000 credits per month covering Sonic text-to-speech (about 27 minutes) and Ink speech-to-text (about 1h51m), plus one voice agent slot and unlimited workspace seats - no card required to start.
claim_steps: Open cartesia.ai/pricing and choose the Free plan ('Start free').
Sign up at play.cartesia.ai - no credit card required.
Generate speech with Sonic or transcribe with Ink from the playground or API.
Stay within the 20K monthly credits; they reset each month.
